## 🎉 Automatic Contributor Recognition

**Good news!** When your PR is merged, you'll be **automatically added** to our contributors list in the README!

- ✨ No extra steps needed
- 🏆 You'll appear with your GitHub avatar and contribution type
- 📊 Your contributions will be tracked and recognized

You can also be manually recognized for other contribution types (like bug reports, documentation, design, etc.) by having a maintainer comment:

```
@all-contributors please add @your-username for doc
```

Learn more about our [automated contributor recognition](https://github.com/AndrewRedican/hyperfrontend/blob/main/.github/AUTOMATED_CONTRIBUTORS.md).
